1 (Currently amended): A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, wherein the studs are spaced at least sixteen inches on center.

2 (Currently amended): The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced at least twenty-four inches on center.

4 (Currently amended): The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad, and at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

6 (Currently amended): The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening in the housing.

11 (Currently amended): The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover that is removable.

13 (Currently amended): The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the wall is a load-bearing wall constructed with standard framing techniques. 

15 (Currently amended): A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements for securing the cooling system within the wall; and a ventilation grill. 

17 (Cancelled): A cooling system, comprising: a cooling system installable within a structure wall, the cooling system configured for evaporatively cooling an indoor area. 

18 (Cancelled): The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the cooling system is placed between wall studs spaced at least sixteen inches on center. 

19 (Cancelled): The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the cooling system is placed within a structure wall, the structure wall constructed using one of structural insulated panels (SIP) and insulating concrete forms (ICF). 

20 (Cancelled): The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the housing protrudes from the wall less than three inches.
